Owns the single staged package producer, base asset/CLI smoke, installed lifecycle restart smoke, and lifecycle receipt binding. Final SDK runner/graph inclusion remains a D3/U4 input dependency.

Owns Relay link admission/lifetime and closeGrant revocation. 4e04166 is bound to docs/design/teams-relay-link-lifetime.md and docs/design/dagpipe/graphs/relay-link.graph.json under required teams-relay-link-topology. Static governance bindings are not Work SDK Operators. The opened pair continues after the admission deadline while original controls/generations stay current; server/relay.spec.ts covers the public TLS/WSS behavior. Public deployment remains deferred.

Work DAGpipe SDK host adapter and runner are implemented as a source-level library consumer (runtime/dagpipe/** with real compiled SDK and provider-ledger tests), and AgentWorkClient capability selection is implemented. The launcher local Work ingress is delivered for the exact candidate: the public CLI/launcher/receiver path and the installed runtime consumer are covered by the installed package user smoke, which drives installed submit/query plus persistent open/request/query/close against installed runtime artifacts. Provider ledger and admission remain Agent-owned; no second daemon or scheduler. The BB driver matrix, Console-offline Work and final user acceptance remain pending.

U5 Console start/stop/status is implemented in source. Runtime owns launcher/supervisor lifecycle facts in [consoleRuntime]; U2 owns the closed schema/serializer, the typed same-lock patch port (writeLocalInternalConsoleRuntime) and the [console] projection. The three lifecycle graphs remain static governance, not registered SDK Operators. Console stop is independent from daemon Work drain; installed lifecycle and browser acceptance remain downstream.
